what: post hoc (D36): tests made while choosing the mesh, not readings. One DFN at the ambient (ORegan2022), the 2C discharge at minus 5 C: the cut-off time on meshes other than uniform with equal points in both particles; and the coupled model's cost at 160 points.

discharge_2C_m5C_t_cut_s.mesh: graded toward the surface (PyBaMM Exponential1DSubMesh, side right, stretch 2.3)

coupled_cost_160_points.case: M50 2C minus 5 C, resolved kernel, two-way

choice: Uniform, 160 points per particle radius (both particles), chosen by the author on 18 November 2026 from four options put to him: a graded mesh at 160 points, uniform 160 points, fewer groups at the settled 640 points, or no coupled runs.
